source: Earthdawn 4E Player's Guide — the Weapons, Armor & Shields, Magical Equipment, and Adventuring Equipment tables (Weapons p.406-410; Armor and Shields p.411-415; Magical Equipment p.415-423; Adventuring Equipment p.423-426; tables on pp.433-439). The reference CATALOG: each entry's mechanics live in an `effects` array in the controlled taxonomy vocabulary, so the engine gathers them exactly as it does racial/discipline effects. A character owns items by name (data/character.json `items: [{ name, equipped }]`) — the numbers are reference, not per-character input.

notes.armor: Worn armor confers Physical/Mystic Armor (damage reducers) via `armor-modifier` effects, and its Initiative penalty via a `characteristic-modifier` on Initiative (measure: step). `living` marks elemental 'living' armor (the only kind an obsidiman may wear atop Natural Armor; PG p.48). `ref` holds display-only stats (cost/weight/availability).
notes.shield: Shields do NOT add to Armor — they raise Physical/Mystic DEFENSE (`defense-modifier`) and carry an Initiative penalty. `shatterThreshold` is display-only reference.
notes.weapon: Weapons carry an `attack-modifier` on the attack's Damage step (target `attack`/`Damage`, `operation: add`, measure: step). Every category — melee, missile, and thrown — adds its Damage Step to the Strength-step base (EFFECT-TAXONOMY v3 §4.1; the base is the engine default, not stored here). STR/DEX minima, size, ranges, and entangle details are display-only in `ref`. Ammo rows from the missile table are separate `ammunition` entries.
notes.blood-charm: Blood charms are activated items: their bonuses are `situational` typed effects (with `scope`), the one-time implant Blood Magic Damage is a `note` and is also captured as numeric `characteristic-modifier` effects (operation: subtract, measure: rating, `condition`: situational, `scope`: implanted) on the Death and Unconsciousness ratings, and the Alchemy-crafting EDN is display-only in `ref`.
notes.healing-aid: Healing aids grant one-shot bonuses encoded as `situational` test modifiers; `edn` (Alchemy crafting difficulty) is display-only in `ref`.
notes.magic-item: Common magic items: numeric, always-relevant mechanics are typed effects; one-shot, non-numeric, or activated properties are `note` effects.
notes.gear: Adventuring gear is mostly display-only (`effects: []`); kits record their contents in a `note`, and items with a specific game rule (e.g. Healing Kit +1 Recovery, chain/rope break tests) carry that rule as an effect.
notes.presentation: PRESENTATION LAYER ONLY. Optional `presentation` object holds display strings for the UI and is never read by the engine — it carries no game mechanics. `shortEffect` is a 3-4 word label shown in the Equipment tile's right-hand space for note-type items; the authoritative rule always lives in `effects` (and its full `summary`). Items with a numeric effect derive their tile label in the view instead, so they carry no `shortEffect`.
